main.description: A public recantation, written to the author's own repo. recant.bisks.net reads this record back off the author's own PDS (see notes/50-oauth-scopes.md's verifyOwnRecord pattern) before ever showing it on the wall, and also discovers every author's history network-wide via public/lib/global-wall.js (com.atproto.sync.listReposByCollection + a getRepo CAR download, no backend of recant's own). One record per apology; multiple are allowed, newest first on the wall. Read by recant (https://recant.bisks.net).

text.description: The apology itself, in the author's own words.

subject.description: Optional short label for what's being apologized for, e.g. 'assuming OpenAI was at fault'.

createdAt.description: When the apology was written, as an ISO 8601 datetime.
